C13 and C09 share isolated language about assistance and an “earnest hope,” but not the child's distinctive acknowledgment-of-gratitude structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Thank you for your wire expressing the appreciation of the people of Mississippi for Federal Bureau of Investigation assistance in Pearl River County.","parent_excerpt":"I wish to thank you for your message of July 21 in which you express personally and on behalf of Lebanon gratitude for the United States' affirmative response to Lebanon's call for assistance.","explanation":"Distinctive parallel construction: thanks for a communication that expresses, on behalf of a population, gratitude or appreciation for federal or United States assistance."},{"child_excerpt":"These agents will of course continue to provide full facilities to help in any way in this matter.","parent_excerpt":"The purpose of our action was to help your country preserve its independence ... and I look forward to further cooperation between the American people and the people of Lebanon","explanation":"Both follow the acknowledgment with an assurance explaining or continuing the offered help, adapting the same response structure from international assistance to a domestic investigation."}]}
